newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska soybean harvest seen nearly complete.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska soybean harvest seen nearly complete.

text.p: Soybean harvest was in full swing and was near completion by the week's end on October 20, according to the weekly crop report from the Nebraska Agricultural Statistics Service.
Ninety-one percent of the crop was harvested as of Sunday, up from last year's pace of 76 percent and above the five-year average of 85 percent.
The state's corn crop was rated 22 percent harvested, versus last year's pace of 31 percent and well below the average of 42 percent.
Fifteen percent of the sorghum crop was harvested, down from 62 percent a year ago and behind the 49 percent average pace.
Ninety-one percent of the wheat crop had emerged, down slightly from last year's rate of 93 percent and the five-year average of 94 percent.
Topsoil moisture was 15 percent short, 83 percent adequate and two percent surplus. Subsoil moisture levels were nine percent short, 89 percent adequate and two percent surplus.
